newsitem.title: CANADA: Sask Pool starts C$6 mln capital upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Sask Pool starts C$6 mln capital upgrade.

text.p: Canada's largest grain handling firm on Thursday said started a C$6 million upgrade to its elevator in this central Saskatchewan town.

"This completes the Pool's long-term goal of providing a full service outlet which includes cleaning, drying and condominium storage for our customers," Saskatchewan Wheat Pool district 14 director Harold Yelland said in a statement.
The capital upgrade began immediately with the addition of a condominium storage facility, increased car loading capacity and cleaning and drying capabilities.
The elevator now has a 10,000 tonne workhouse.
A 22,000 tonne storage annex will be added with 18,000 tonnes to be leased to farmers as condominium storage.
The elevator's car spot will rise to 100 from 42.
Export-standard cleaning capacity will be 120 tonnes an hour while drying capacity will be 25 tonnes an hour.
